name: Taste New Mexico
old_description: Sharing the finest, hand-crafted artisan food products grown and produced in the Land of Enchantment since 2002.
about:
Taste New Mexico operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it was founded in 2002 as an online marketplace for artisan foods produced in the state. The company maintains a retail shop at 1301 Cuesto Abajo Ct NE and ships nationwide.

The business curates and sells a range of shelf-stable products from New Mexican brands such as Santa Fe Seasons, Rio Grande Roasters, and Santa Fe Gourmet. Offerings include Hatch chile salsas and sauces, piñon coffee, biscochitos, popcorn, soup mixes, and gift bundles. The company describes itself as a distributor of these products worldwide, fulfilling orders through its e-commerce site and physical location.

Customers include retail consumers seeking authentic New Mexican flavors, as well as wholesale buyers looking for certified Hatch chile and NM True Certified products. The company serves the specialty food and gourmet gift markets across the continental United States, with free shipping on orders over $100.

Taste New Mexico emphasizes its NM True Certified and Certified Hatch Chile Food Vendor designations as marks of authenticity. It promotes family recipes passed down through generations and guarantees that all products are traditionally made in New Mexico.
